action.rationale: Fresh problem with dim=10 and budget=100; since budget < 20·dim, run lightweight probes (P1–P3) to learn structure while spending ~12% of budget. No incumbent yet, so evidence is needed to pick between local vs global methods.

Probes indicate weak global structure (P2 fdc_spearman = 0.252, top10_spread_vs_uniform = 1.164) with cheap, deterministic evaluations and a small total budget (100). To hedge, race a population method (CMA-ES) against a model-based method (TuRBO) for 20% of the budget to see which gains faster before committing the remainder.

CMA-ES just won the race and achieved 2365.10 from 4841.99 in only 10 evals, while TuRBO lagged at 9327.4. The active CMA-ES has 0 evals in tenure with sigma=5.35 and popsize=10, indicating it hasn’t yet explored; with 68 evals left, a full round (50) is a good investment before polishing.

Only 18 evals remain and CMA-ES has not improved for 35 evals; it’s time to refine the incumbent. BOBYQA needs 2·dim+1=21 evals to start in d=10, exceeding the remaining budget, so L-BFGS-B is the viable fast local choice on this deterministic problem.
